text: What is the primary driver — data-centre exit / lease end, cost, resilience, M&A, regulatory, capability? Is there a hard date?
Is there a fixed budget envelope or funding model for the migration programme?
What does “done” look like — full exit, hybrid steady-state, or a first tranche only?
Target Azure region(s) and any data-residency constraint on region choice?
Appetite for change during migration — pure rehost (“lift & shift”) vs opportunistic modernisation?
Known business blackout periods (year-end, peak trading, regulatory reporting)?
Who is the executive sponsor, and who signs off wave go/no-go?
Is there an incumbent partner / MSP whose scope or contracts we must work around?
Existing agreement type — EA, MCA, CSP? Renewal date?
Is there an Azure Consumption Commitment (MACC) this programme could retire against?
Any active Microsoft funding (AMM / Azure Migrate and Modernize, ECIF) already in play, and which Microsoft account team?
Software Assurance coverage on Windows Server / SQL Server — quantities eligible for Azure Hybrid Benefit?
Commitment appetite for Reserved Instances / Savings Plans (1yr / 3yr) to reduce run-rate?
Is a post-migration managed-run service in scope of this RFP or separate?
Hypervisor(s) and version — VMware (vSphere ver.), Hyper-V, Nutanix, bare metal count?
Total VMs by environment (prod / non-prod / dev / DR) and by OS family + version?
Any unsupported / end-of-life OS (Windows 2008/2012, RHEL 6, etc.) — counts?
Physical servers that cannot be virtualised, and why?
Specialised compute — GPU, HPC clusters, large-memory (> 512 GB) hosts?
Appliances / non-x86 — mainframe, AS/400, network appliances, hardware dongles?
Typical utilisation profile — are hosts heavily over-provisioned? Any known idle/zombie servers?
Server build standard / golden image, and patching toolset?
Total allocated vs used capacity — block, file, object — by tier?
Storage arrays / NAS in use, and any that back multiple apps (shared LUNs, CIFS/NFS shares)?
Performance-sensitive volumes — IOPS / throughput / latency targets?
Backup product, backup windows, retention policy, and off-site / immutable copy?
Any archive / WORM / regulatory-retention data, and volumes?
Large data sets to seed to Azure — is offline transfer (Data Box) needed, or is bandwidth sufficient?
Database engines, versions, and instance/DB counts — SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, others?
Largest databases (size), and any with strict RPO/RTO or 24×7 no-downtime needs?
HA/DR config today — Always On AG, clustering, log shipping, Data Guard, RAC?
Openness to PaaS targets (Azure SQL MI / Flexible Server) vs IaaS-only?
Oracle licensing model and any constraint on running Oracle in Azure?
Middleware / integration — message brokers, ESB, MFT, batch schedulers, app servers?
Certificates, service accounts, hardcoded IPs / hostnames known to be embedded in apps?
Confirmed application count, and completeness of the portfolio list (is it maintained?)
For each app: business criticality (1–4), user base, peak usage pattern?
Apps already earmarked to Retire or replace with SaaS in the next 12–18 months?
COTS/vendor apps — is the vendor's support statement for Azure known? Any that block migration?
Custom/in-house apps — source code availability, active dev team, build pipeline?
Internet-facing apps and their current WAF / load-balancer / CDN arrangement?
Apps with hardware dependencies (dongles, fax, telephony, SCADA, lab equipment)?
Apps under active change freeze, audit, or major project that constrains timing?
Who can authorise and perform UAT for each app, and is that capacity available?
Is a dependency map maintained? If not, how are integrations currently understood — SMEs, docs, tribal knowledge?
Known “chatty” app-to-app or app-to-DB pairs that must move together?
External / third-party integrations (partners, SaaS, payment, gov) and how they authenticate / whitelist IPs?
Shared services everything depends on — AD, DNS, NTP, SMTP, file shares, print, monitoring?
Latency-sensitive integrations that will not tolerate a hybrid (on-prem ↔ Azure) hop during transition?
Current WAN — carrier, bandwidth, MPLS/SD-WAN, and spare capacity for migration traffic?
Preferred Azure connectivity — ExpressRoute (bandwidth?), VPN, or both? Is a circuit already ordered?
On-prem IP address plan — RFC1918 ranges in use, and any overlap risk with Azure/partners?
Can applications tolerate re-IP, or must IPs be preserved (hardcoded, firewall rules, licences)?
DNS design — internal zones, split-horizon, who manages it?
Perimeter today — firewalls (vendor), IDS/IPS, proxy, DDoS — and which must be replicated in Azure?
Egress / internet breakout model, and any forced-tunnelling or inspection requirement?
Existing Azure footprint / networking we must integrate with (existing hub, subscriptions)?
Active Directory — forest/domain structure, DC locations, functional level?
Entra ID (Azure AD) in use today? Entra Connect / federation (ADFS)? Licence tier (P1/P2)?
Will AD extend to Azure (DCs in Azure / Entra Domain Services), or is greenfield identity possible?
Privileged access model — PAM tooling, break-glass, admin tiering?
Service accounts / Kerberos / gMSA usage that migration must preserve?
Regulatory / compliance regimes in scope — PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOX, ISO 27001, local data laws?
Data classification scheme, and any data that may not leave a jurisdiction or must be encrypted with customer-managed keys?
Mandated security controls / baselines (CIS, NIST, internal standard) the landing zone must meet?
Current SIEM / SOC — will it consume Azure logs, or is Microsoft Sentinel in scope?
Vulnerability management, endpoint protection, and CASB tooling to carry forward or replace?
Pen-test / security sign-off gates required before go-live?
Approval needed to place client data in our Data Lake for this assessment — who signs, and any redaction required?
ITSM platform (ServiceNow, etc.) and change-management process / CAB cadence?
Monitoring & alerting stack today, and target — Azure Monitor, keep existing, hybrid?
Standard maintenance windows by environment, and typical approved downtime for a cutover?
Runbook / automation maturity — IaC, config management (Ansible, DSC, Puppet)?
Who operates the estate post-migration — client, us, third party — and target operating model?
Tagging / naming / cost-allocation standards to enforce in Azure?
RPO / RTO targets by application tier?
Current DR approach — second DC, cold/warm/hot, and when it was last tested?
Target Azure resilience — single region + AZ, region pair, active/active? Any app that needs multi-region?
Backup retention & restore-test obligations to meet in Azure?
Is the migration itself the DR event (i.e. no rollback), or is a fallback to on-prem required per wave?
Performance SLAs users expect (response time, batch completion) that must be held or improved?
Availability SLAs contractually committed to the business or to external customers?
Sustainability / carbon reporting objectives tied to this programme?
Constraints on our team — security clearance, on-site presence, working hours, nationality, background checks?
Tooling constraints — can we use ASR, DMS, Azure Migrate agentless from Azure side, or is even that disallowed?
Language / documentation / handover format requirements?
Preferred wave sizing — by business unit, by DC rack, by app affinity, by risk?
Any “wave zero” pilot candidates — low-risk apps the client is happy to move first?
Cutover windows available — weeknights, weekends, how many per month?
Acceptable coexistence period (how long on-prem and Azure run in parallel)?
Data-centre exit hard stop / lease end date driving the overall schedule?
Client resources committed to the programme (app owners, DBAs, testers, network) — named and available?
